archetypes.name: lock-safety
archetypes.rationale: Stale-lock cleanup must avoid deleting active git locks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the stale .git/index.lock detection and removal policy. Focus on zero-byte checks, active-holder detection, fail-closed behavior, and whether unrelated git processes can incorrectly block cleanup. Verify retry behavior runs at most once and preserves diagnostics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: step5-envelope
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 must surface stale locks without breaking stall recovery classification.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the review-and-fix integration around RoundCommitResult and CODER_STATUS. Confirm stale-index-lock returns do not trigger cleanup/fallback, STALL_REASON remains coder-failed, and commit_fixes plus lint-fix commits route staging through cli.py git commit. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: regression-fit
archetypes.rationale: The new tests span git helpers and review-and-fix monkeypatch contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the regression tests for realistic stale-lock scenarios and harness stability. Check temp repo setup, monkeypatch signatures, private helper assertions, and whether the tests cover both successful cleanup and refused removal without brittle platform assumptions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
